В українській «поради», «меблі», «новини: In Ukrainian “advice”, “furniture” and “news” feel plural, but in English these words are uncountable: no -s and no a / an. To count one item, use a piece of.
News закінчується на -s, але це однина:: News ends in -s, but it is singular: the news is. People, on the other hand, has no -s but is plural: people are. Jeans, trousers and glasses are always plural too.
A / an перед незлічуваним: A / an before an uncountable noun
A / an означає «одна штука», тому з незл: A / an means “one item”, so we don’t use it with uncountable nouns. Use some or a piece of instead.
Неправильна множина і як порахувати незл: Irregular plurals and how to count uncountable nouns
Ці форми не підкоряються правилам, їх ва: These forms don’t follow the rules, so it is worth learning them by heart. Table: singular, plural or the “unit”, translation.

After s we add -es: bus → buses.
Consonant + y: y → ies, city → cities. Citys is wrong.

-f → -ves: leaf → leaves. Дієслово are т: -f → -ves: leaf → leaves. The verb are also shows it is plural.
Tomato входить у групу слів на -o з -es:: Tomato is one of the -o words that take -es: tomatoes.

Consonant r + y: y → ies, libraries.

Foot → feet (неправильна множина). Дієсл: Foot → feet (irregular). The verb hurt without -s also shows a plural.

After sh we add -es: dish → dishes.

Неправильна множина: mouse → mice. Mouse: An irregular plural: mouse → mice. Mouses and mices are wrong.
Consonant b + y: y → ies, babies.
After ch we add -es: watch → watches.
